title: Back up
description: Copies the entity's folders to <destination>/<data location>/<the same path>. A file whose copy has the same size and is not older is left alone, so running it again copies only what changed.

destination.title: Destination
destination.description: Folder to copy into; a relative path is inside the project folder

dataLocation.title: Data location
dataLocation.description: Only this data location; empty for all of them

overwrite.title: Copy every file again
overwrite.description: Also copy files whose copy looks up to date
